## About
Cerise Auto Body is a body shop on Cerise Avenue in Hawthorne, just off El Segundo Blvd, between Crenshaw Blvd and Prairie Ave. We're close to the freeways and easy to get to.
Sam and the team handle damage from collisions along with smaller jobs like tail lights, emblems and window tinting. We're rated 4.5 on Google from 29 reviews.
We're open Monday through Friday. If you're coming by, call ahead or send us an e-mail and we'll be ready for you.

## Services
- Collision damage: Damage from a collision, fixed by Sam and the team.
- Tail lights and emblems: One reviewer had tail lights done and emblems colored here.
- Window tinting: Tint for the windshield and front windows.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get there from the freeway?
A: We're three miles east of the 405, one mile southwest of the 105 and three miles west of the 110, between Crenshaw Blvd and Prairie Ave.

Q: How can I reach you?
A: Call us at (310) 219-0900 or e-mail service@ceriseautobody.com.
